question: Can the exact 2018-09-30 original SOXX schedule yield 30 positive common-equity values that close to its printed Total Common Stocks, before filling the 2019 Qlib prefix?
formula: Starting at the verified SOXX schedule title, parse Common Stocks Security/Shares/Value rows up to printed Total Common Stocks; require 20-40 distinct names, positive shares and original USD values, zero ambiguous numeric security rows, and sum-minus-printed difference <=1 USD. Normalize each original security value by parsed common-stock value sum; top5 is largest five normalized weights, HHI is sum squared weights. No ticker mapping or index-weight inference.
stop: Any hash, row ambiguity, count or printed-total closure failure stops this fixed parse; preserve failure and require a separately frozen mechanical repair before another source read.
